name: OpenBao
description: Installs the OpenBao CLI (bao), the open-source fork of HashiCorp Vault. API-compatible with Vault, so VAULT_ADDR/VAULT_TOKEN and the community.hashi_vault Ansible collection work against it.

version.description: Version of OpenBao to install. "latest" resolves the newest stable tag at build time; give an exact version to pin.
